in_latin.name: Elazarus
in_latin.long_meaning: El-azorus: El-azorus, El-azorus, El-azorus. In Christian tradition, El-azorus signifies a helper of God, a name associated with the biblical figure Lazarus. The name has been used in various forms throughout history, including the Greek form Lazarus, and has been a popular choice for Christian parents seeking a name with spiritual significance.
